movelist.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is lowered 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Roar
movelist.effect: When declaring Roar, the user does nothing and may not Shift. At the end of the round, the user Shifts and uses Roar.  Targets hit by Roar immediately Shift away from the target using their highest usable movement capability, and towards their Trainer if possible. If the target is an owned Pokémon and ends this shift within 6 meters of their Poké Ball, they are immediately recalled to their Poké Ball. If that Trainer sends out a replacement, they do not lose their Pokémon turn.

movelist.name: Tail Whip
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Powder Snow
movelist.effect: Powder Snow Freezes all Legal Targets on 19+.

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. This is increased to +2 Evasion while in Hail or snowy terrain. While in Hail, the user and adjacent allies do not lose Hit Points due to the Hail.
